integrity: Explicit mathematical proof and independently implemented finite-state numerical comparisons. Prior art remains a residual historical risk; not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Zero-field, pure ferromagnetic cross-coupling only; m >= n; critical-window TV estimates with beta=1+lambda/sqrt(n), bounded lambda; joint asymptotic n/m -> 0; no inference for broader interaction matrices or dynamics.
title: Minority-controlled critical fluctuations in an imbalanced bipartite Ising ferromagnet
